project: Weave Self-Iteration US-444 Subscription Gate Hardening
description: Small Ralph self-iteration for branch ralph/self-iteration-20260519-082247. The previous PRD belonged to ralph/self-iteration-20260519-073710 and all stories were passing, so it was archived under scripts/ralph/archive/self-iteration-20260519-082749/. No PR CI auto-fix context was present in progress.txt. Kickoff health: latest completed PR CI run 26067989274 was green; latest completed main CI run 26066339689 was green; fresh main CI run 26068337937 was still in progress with Web job green and Go job in race/coverage tests. Local health sampled green with go test ./... and npm --prefix web test -- --run. Known fresh-CI web embed and US-453 streamless binary-response risks are already covered by committed BDD tests. Dogfood DOG-001 through DOG-005 are also covered in this checkout, so this PRD focuses on remaining upper-layer E2E probes that can still hide wired-service regressions behind skips or shallow checks.

userStories.name: Make US-444 subscribe gate require the WebSocket subscribe handshake
userStories.description: Strengthen the US-444 subscribe Playwright probe so a reachable backend must emit the WebSocket welcome frame and accept an explicit object subscription instead of treating a quiet or unwired subscription surface as a skip.
bdd_acceptance: Given the US-444 suite runs against a reachable full-stack backend, When us444/20-subscribe.spec.ts opens /api/v2/ontologies/northwind/subscriptions/ws, Then absence of the welcome frame fails the test instead of calling test.skip.

Given the welcome frame is received, When the spec sends a subscribe envelope for the seeded customer ObjectType, Then the next server frame must be a subscribed acknowledgement with a non-empty subscriptionId.
Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When the subscribe spec is parsed, Then the scenario remains discoverable and contains no skip guard for quiet or unwired subscription endpoints.
quality_gates: `rg -n "no welcome frame|endpoint unwired or quiet|test\\.skip\\(firstMessage" web/e2e/us444/20-subscribe.spec.ts` must return no matches

userStories.name: Make VTX-099 system graph gate reject unwired graph pages
userStories.description: Strengthen the VTX-099 Playwright probe so a reachable backend must expose the system graph page and render graph content rather than skipping when the page appears unwired.
bdd_acceptance: Given the backend health endpoint is reachable, When vtx-099-system-graph-render.spec.ts opens the system graph page, Then a missing or empty graph page fails instead of being skipped.
Given graph data renders, When the probe inspects the page, Then it asserts a non-empty system graph signal rather than only page reachability.
Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When the VTX-099 spec is parsed, Then its scenarios remain discoverable and contain no systemGraphReachable test.skip guard.
quality_gates: `rg -n "systemGraphReachable|test\\.skip" web/e2e/vtx-099-system-graph-render.spec.ts` should only allow the shared backend-down guard after the story is implemented

userStories.name: Align US-444 helper docs with mandatory wired-service gates
userStories.description: Remove stale US-444 helper and README guidance that tells future probes to skip optional 404/503 feature endpoints, keeping only the backend-down portability guard as the accepted skip path.
bdd_acceptance: Given a future contributor reads web/e2e/us444/helpers.ts, When they follow the helper comments, Then they see that backend-down is the portability skip and wired service failures should be assertions.
Given a future contributor reads web/e2e/us444/README.md, When they add a US-444 probe, Then the documentation directs them to fail reachable-but-unwired endpoints rather than skip 404/503 responses.
Given Playwright spec contract tests run, When the helper and README sources are inspected, Then stale optional-feature skip wording is rejected.
quality_gates: `rg -n "optional feature|404.*503.*skip|feature surface returns 503/404|endpoint unavailable" web/e2e/us444/README.md web/e2e/us444/helpers.ts` must return no stale optional-skip guidance after the story is implemented
